channel.title: On Device AI News
channel.description: Product updates and practical guides from On Device AI.

item.title: How to Share a Private Knowledge Base as One Encrypted File
item.description: Export a Knowledge Library as an encrypted Knowledge Pack, protect it with a password, and hand it to a colleague. The recipient imports a library that is searchable immediately, with no cloud account and no re-indexing.

item.title: Turn Documents and Feeds Into a Private Listening Queue
item.description: The new Listen Library gathers PDFs, articles, scanned books, and RSS feeds into one private place you can read or listen to, with Up Next, a sleep timer, and on-device OCR.

item.title: App Help and Faster Widgets
item.description: Ask App Help how a feature works without mixing help into saved chats, and reach Listen, Voice Note, Text Note, and Quick Actions from new widgets on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

item.title: Make On Device AI Part of Your Shortcuts
item.description: Use Siri and Shortcuts to create notes, open saved work, transcribe audio, and generate speech with On Device AI.

item.title: From Recording to Follow-Up
item.description: Turn a private recording into a transcript, reusable project context, and a reviewed next step with On Device AI.

item.title: A Better Home for Project Context
item.description: Keep notes, saved AI Search results, transcripts, and project files together in a private Knowledge Library with On Device AI.

item.title: The Only AI App That Collects Zero Data
item.description: While most 'private' AI apps still phone home, On Device AI has been built from the ground up on a true zero-telemetry architecture. Our App Store privacy label reads 'Data Not Collected'.

item.title: The Offline Recording and Transcription App Built for Real Notes
item.description: On Device AI records, transcribes, labels speakers, and summarizes voice notes offline on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Apple STT, Whisper, Parakeet, Nemotron, and Qwen3-ASR.

item.title: On-Device TTS, Voice Cloning, and Cleaner Reference Audio
item.description: On Device AI adds more local text-to-speech choices, voice cloning workflows, and optional noisy-speech cleanup for reference audio on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

item.title: Speaker Diarization & Meeting Transcription — On Device AI
item.description: On Device AI turns recordings into private meeting transcripts with automatic speaker labels, tunable diarization settings, and export to text, SRT, or Markdown — all on-device.

item.title: Voice Typing Everywhere: iOS Keyboard Extension & macOS Input Method
item.description: Our custom iOS keyboard extension and macOS input method bring secure, offline AI-powered voice typing with real-time Whisper transcription and smart correction modes to any application.

item.title: On Device AI Browser Agent: Private AI Web Automation for Mac & iPad
item.description: On Device AI Browser Agent is a private AI assistant for Mac, iPad, and iPhone that opens real websites, fills forms, and brings answers back to your chat, without sending pages to the cloud.

item.title: Multi-Agent AI on Your Device: Subagent Delegation and Parallel Workflows in On Device AI
item.description: On Device AI adds two multi-agent modes: subagent delegation for expert task routing, and Chat Flow for parallel agent responses. Both run entirely on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

item.title: Supply Chain Security: Why We Built OnDeviceAI Natively
item.description: Recent supply chain attacks on tools like Axios and LiteLLM expose the risks of web dependencies. See why On Device AI is built on native Apple technologies for maximum security.

item.title: Private AI Autopilot for Discord, Slack & Telegram | On Device AI
item.description: Use On Device AI on macOS to run a private AI bot for Discord, Slack, and Telegram with local message processing and no cloud AI dependency.

item.title: Apple's March 2026 MacBooks: Which Tier Actually Makes Sense for Local AI?
item.description: Apple's March 2026 MacBook lineup—Neo, Air M5, and Pro M5 Max—covers $599 to $3,199. Here's what each tier actually delivers for on-device AI with On Device AI.

item.title: Best Local Private AI Apps for iPhone, iPad & Mac (2026)
item.description: What makes the best local private AI apps on Apple devices in 2026? See why MLX, GGUF, offline workflows, voice, vision, and knowledge tools matter.

item.title: Private Knowledge Workflow for PDFs, Notes & Web Pages
item.description: See how On Device AI turns PDFs, web pages, OCR images, and notes into a private Knowledge Library workflow with local retrieval and grounded answers.
